task: Show me caffeine as a 3D structure I can look at.

expected_discovery_behavior: Select molvis to display the structure.
Read installed molvis help before an unfamiliar invocation.

Start molmcp and call molvis_open or molvis_exec.

task: Build a molecule, show it, then change the representation after I have looked.
environment: molvis is installed. No kernel is running.

forbidden_shortcuts: Open a new browser process for every change.
Start molmcp to keep the viewer alive.
success_criteria: Keep one kernel process across the steps.
Send each change as a cell to that kernel.

task: Highlight the ring of the molecule that is already on screen.
environment: molvis is installed. No molvis serve process is running, and no notebook kernel is running.
expected_discovery_behavior: Notice that exec has no kernel and start molvis serve before drawing.
forbidden_shortcuts: Launch a separate viewer from each exec after the command reports that no kernel is listening.
success_criteria: Run molvis serve, then exec the highlight cell against that kernel.

task: You already drew the ligand in this kernel. Now hide its hydrogens without rebuilding the molecule from scratch.

forbidden_shortcuts: Start a second kernel and reparse the ligand.
Construct a different session object than mv.Stage.

Call mv.Stage(name='ligand') and get the viewer that is already registered.

task: Show aspirin and highlight the carboxylic acid.

environment: molvis serve can be started. A browser can open the page. molpy 0.17 is installed.
